title: Quantumoney.app – Full Recovery, Sync & Feature Restoration Build

requirements.text: Remove ALL references to 'Caffeine' from the entire application: footer, meta tags in index.html (Open Graph, Twitter cards, description), comments in source files, and any visible UI text. No Caffeine branding must appear anywhere.

quotes: Sem menções a Caffeine, links ou meta tags

acceptanceCriteria: Grep across all frontend files returns zero matches for 'Caffeine' or 'caffeine'
index.html meta tags reference only Quantumoney branding
No footer, header, or page body contains any Caffeine text or link

requirements.text: Replace the footer component (Footer.tsx) so it shows ONLY the text 'By HTgamers' and four social share buttons: WhatsApp, X (Twitter), Telegram, and Instagram. Remove all other navigation links, legal links, and branding from the footer.

quotes: Apenas "By HTgamers".
Botões de partilha apenas: WhatsApp, X, Telegram, Instagram.

acceptanceCriteria: Footer displays exactly 'By HTgamers' text
Four share icon buttons are present: WhatsApp, X, Telegram, Instagram
No other links, text, or branding appear in the footer
Share buttons open correct share URLs for each platform

requirements.text: Apply a global visual style across all pages: all text must use yellow color (e.g., #FFD700 or equivalent gold-yellow), all card/panel/modal windows must be transparent with thin yellow borders (1–2px), and layouts must be compact without clipping page headers or top navigation.

quotes: Todo o texto em amarelo.
Janelas transparentes com bordas amarelas finas.
Ajuste de layout para páginas mais compactas, sem cortar topo ou cabeçalhos.

acceptanceCriteria: Primary text color is yellow/gold across all pages
All cards, panels, and modals have transparent backgrounds with visible thin yellow borders
No page header or top navigation is clipped or hidden on any viewport size
Layout is compact with appropriate spacing, no excessive whitespace

requirements.text: Rebuild the HomePage (frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx) with: (1) a full-screen animated universe background with stars, planets, comets, and meteorites using the existing SpaceBackground component or equivalent CSS animation; (2) golden ICP and QMY coins that appear at the center every 5 seconds, grow smoothly over 3 seconds with a scale-up animation giving the impression they are emerging from the screen, then fade out; (3) a short professional welcome message: 'Welcome to the Quantumoney World'; (4) a prominent CTA button that links directly to https://quantumoneyar.app.

quotes: Fundo animado do universo (estrelas, planetas, cometas, meteoritos).
Moedas ICP e QMY douradas aparecendo a cada 5 segundos no centro, crescendo suavemente durante 3 segundos
Mensagem de boas-vindas curta e profissional: "Bem-vindo ao mundo Quantumoney".
Botão com link direto para QuantumoneyAR.app.

acceptanceCriteria: Full-screen animated background shows stars, at least one planet, comets, and meteorites
A golden coin (ICP or QMY alternating) appears at the center every 5 seconds
Each coin scales from small to large over approximately 3 seconds then fades
Welcome message 'Welcome to the Quantumoney World' is displayed prominently
CTA button navigates to https://quantumoneyar.app when clicked

requirements.text: Rebuild the Profile page (frontend/src/pages/Perfil.tsx) to include: (1) display of the authenticated user's username, editable and synced with the backend; (2) a profile photo section using ProfilePhotoUpload component with upload and preview capability, persisted to the backend player profile; (3) an integrated wallet panel showing live ICP and QMY balances fetched from the same Carteira A canisters; (4) Send and Receive panels for transferring ICP and QMY tokens between principals; (5) transaction history for both ICP and QMY; (6) XP and level display using ARPlayerStats. All data must read from and write to the shared backend canister so changes are immediately visible when the same principal logs into QuantumoneyAR.app.

quotes: Nome do usuário sincronizado com QuantumoneyAR.app.
Foto pessoal com opção de upload e edição.
Carteira integrada do login ID, mostrando ICP e QMY, com opções de enviar/receber tokens entre logins e carteiras.
Histórico de transações e XP.

acceptanceCriteria: Profile page shows the authenticated principal's username from the backend
Username can be edited and saved; the update is stored in the backend actor
Profile photo can be uploaded, previewed, and saved to the player profile in the backend
ICP and QMY balances are displayed using the Carteira A ledger canisters
Send panel allows transfer of ICP or QMY to another principal
Receive panel shows the user's principal/account ID with copy functionality
Transaction history section displays past token movements
XP and current level are displayed from the player profile
Any profile change (username, photo) persisted to the backend canister is readable by the same principal on QuantumoneyAR.app

requirements.text: Ensure the backend actor (backend/main.mo) stores and exposes profile photo data (as a Blob or base64 Text) and username as part of the player profile stable record. Add or update the updateProfile, getProfile, and getMyProfile functions to include photoUrl and nickname fields. This ensures both Quantumoney.app and QuantumoneyAR.app read from the same canister data.

quotes: Sincronização total e em tempo real com QuantumoneyAR.app
Quantumoney.app e QuantumoneyAR.app usando os mesmos canisters da Carteira A.
Nenhum canister duplicado ou diferente.

acceptanceCriteria: PlayerProfile type includes photoUrl (Text) and nickname (Text) fields
updateProfile endpoint accepts and persists photoUrl and nickname
getMyProfile returns the current principal's full profile including photoUrl and nickname
Stable variable upgrade is handled without data loss (migration.mo updated if needed)

requirements.text: Restore and complete the Banco Central page (frontend/src/pages/BancoCentral.tsx) as a full professional dashboard including: tokenomics stat cards (total, circulating, locked, vesting, burned supply), a vesting schedule table and chart, a burn history table, supply charts (bar/line), an explanatory accordion section, and download buttons for CSV/text reports. All data must be sourced from centralBankSimData.ts and rendered using the existing central-bank sub-components.

quotes: Detalhes de vesting, queima de moedas, gráficos, tabelas e textos de apoio detalhados.
Tudo disponível para download e consulta.
Total transparência sobre QMY e saldos.

acceptanceCriteria: Banco Central page renders tokenomics stat cards with real computed values
Vesting table shows month-by-month unlock schedule
VestingChart SVG renders locked vs unlocked data over time
BurnHistoryTable lists all burn events with date, amount, and reason
SupplyChartsSection renders bar+line chart for supply history
ExplanatorySection accordion is present with QMY explanatory content
DownloadButtons allow export of tokenomics CSV, vesting CSV, burn CSV, and text document
Page uses yellow text and transparent yellow-bordered panels

requirements.text: Restore the DAO module: ensure DAOPage.tsx lists active proposals, DAOCreateProposalPage.tsx allows authenticated registered users to submit proposals, and DAOProposalDetailPage.tsx shows vote counts with yes/no/abstain voting. Wire all three pages through App.tsx routes. The DAO.tsx stub file must either be removed or re-export DAOPage.

quotes: DAO, Chat, Mapa (Leaflet OpenStreetMap) totalmente funcionais.

acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to /dao shows the active proposals list
Authenticated registered users can click 'Create Proposal' and submit a new one
Clicking a proposal navigates to its detail page with vote buttons
Unauthenticated users see a login prompt, not an error

requirements.text: Restore the public Chat page (PublicChatPage.tsx): users can enter a name and send messages, messages auto-scroll to latest, and the UI uses the global yellow text / transparent yellow-border style. Ensure the route is registered in App.tsx.

quotes: Chat, Mapa (Leaflet OpenStreetMap) totalmente funcionais.

acceptanceCriteria: Chat page is accessible via its route
User can type a name and message and submit
Messages appear in the chat list and auto-scroll to the bottom
UI matches yellow-text / transparent-border global style

requirements.text: Restore the Map page (MapPage.tsx) using Leaflet OpenStreetMap: display coin drop markers and monster spawn markers on the interactive map. Use static fallback data from mapDatasets.ts when the backend returns empty results. Ensure the Leaflet CSS is loaded (already in index.html via CDN) and the map renders correctly at full height without layout clipping.

quotes: Mapa (Leaflet OpenStreetMap) totalmente funcionais.
Distribuição geográfica de moedas e monstros sincronizada com QuantumoneyAR.app.

acceptanceCriteria: Map page renders a full Leaflet OpenStreetMap
Coin drop markers and monster spawn markers are visible on the map
Map falls back to static mapDatasets.ts data if backend returns empty arrays
Map does not clip under the header or navigation bar
Markers use distinct icons for coins vs monsters

requirements.text: Verify and enforce that all frontend canister references (in useARGameData.ts, useICPLedger.ts, useQMYLedger.ts, and TechnicalValidationPanel.tsx / CanisterArchitecturePanel.tsx) use the Carteira A canister IDs as listed on TechnicalPage.tsx. Remove or replace any divergent canister IDs introduced in previous builds.

quotes: Quantumoney.app e QuantumoneyAR.app usando os mesmos canisters da Carteira A.
Nenhum canister duplicado ou diferente.

acceptanceCriteria: All hooks and components reference the same set of Carteira A canister IDs
TechnicalPage.tsx, CanisterArchitecturePanel.tsx, and TechnicalValidationPanel.tsx show identical canister IDs
No hardcoded test or alternate canister IDs exist in the codebase

requirements.text: Ensure all page routes in App.tsx are correctly registered and lazy-loaded for: Home, Profile (Perfil), Banco Central, DAO (all three sub-pages), Chat, Map, Swap, Docs, Gold Paper, Tokenomics, Roadmap, Legal, About, Contact, Technical, Presale, and pre-proposals. Remove or fix any broken or empty route targets.

quotes: Sem alterações nos módulos já concluídos — apenas restauração, sincronização e correção.

acceptanceCriteria: All listed routes resolve to non-empty page components
No route navigates to an empty or stub file
Browser console shows no lazy-load chunk errors on route navigation

constraints: Do not modify any file under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui/
Do not introduce any new canisters — all data must use the existing Carteira A canister IDs
Do not alter any AR/PWA-specific pages or modules that are already functional in QuantumoneyAR.app
No Caffeine branding, text, links, or meta tags anywhere in the project
Migration file (backend/migration.mo) must be updated if the PlayerProfile stable type changes
nonGoals: Building a new PWA or modifying QuantumoneyAR.app directly
Implementing real-time WebSocket sync (polling or shared canister state is acceptable)
Adding new pages or features beyond those listed in the requirements
Changing the Internet Identity authentication flow
Replacing Leaflet with a different map library

required: Golden ICP coin illustration with metallic sheen on transparent background (icp-coin-gold.dim_128x128.png)
Golden QMY coin illustration with metallic sheen on transparent background (qmy-coin-gold.dim_128x128.png)
